description: This file defines the HttpClient class for handling HTTP operations such as file download, with support for rate limiting, progress tracking, and SSL configuration. It also includes a utility class for tracing function entry and exit.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A class providing HTTP client functionalities including file download, progress monitoring, rate limiting, and SSL configuration.

classes.name: trace_exit
classes.description: A utility class for tracing function entry and exit for debugging purposes.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from the specified URL to a local filename with optional rate limiting.

methods.name: setRateLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum receive speed for the transfer.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns the current progress of the transfer.

methods.name: setCertPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the SSL certificate (placeholder implementation).

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code of the last request.
